//go:build e2e

package executor

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func trialOut() string { return os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT") }

func trialNum(sh string) int64 {
	out, _ := exec.Command("bash", "-c", ". "+os.Getenv("TRIAL_LIB")+"; "+sh).Output()
	var n int64
	_, _ = fmt.Sscan(string(out), &n)
	return n
}

// trialStage runs fn and records its seconds, what the runner received and what its disk gained.
func trialStage(t *testing.T, name string, fn func() error) error {
	t.Helper()
	rx, used, began := trialNum("rx"), trialNum("used"), time.Now()
	err := fn()
	row := fmt.Sprintf("%s\t%.1f\t%d\t%d\t%v\n", name, time.Since(began).Seconds(), trialNum("rx")-rx, trialNum("used")-used, err)
	f, _ := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(trialOut(), "stages.tsv"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	_, _ = f.WriteString(row)
	_ = f.Close()
	fmt.Print("STAGE ", row)
	df, _ := exec.Command("docker", "system", "df", "-v").CombinedOutput()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(trialOut(), "df-"+strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-")+".txt"), df, 0o600)
	return err
}

type trialApp struct{ name, dir string }

func trialApps() []trialApp {
	return []trialApp{
		{"claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal"}, {"endorsement-hub", "../demo/apps/endorsement-hub"},
		{"claims-archive", "../demo/apps/claims-archive"}, {"premium-ledger", "../demo/apps/premium-ledger"},
		{"django-sqlite", "testdata/apps/django-sqlite"}, {"go-hello", os.Getenv("TRIAL_GO")},
	}
}

func trialBuild(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, e *Executor, stage, app, dir, pkg string) (BuildResult, error) {
	t.Helper()
	var log bytes.Buffer
	var res BuildResult
	tree := treeOf(t, dir)
	err := trialStage(t, stage, func() (err error) {
		res, err = e.Build(ctx, BuildRequest{App: app, Package: pkg}, tree, &log)
		return err
	})
	file := strings.ReplaceAll(stage, " ", "-")
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(trialOut(), "log-"+file+".txt"), log.Bytes(), 0o600)
	if err == nil {
		ran, _ := json.Marshal(res.Buildpacks)
		inspect, _ := exec.Command("docker", "image", "inspect", strings.TrimPrefix(res.Image, "canyon/"+app+"@")).Output()
		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(trialOut(), "image-"+file+".json"), inspect, 0o600)
		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(trialOut(), "ran-"+file+".json"), ran, 0o600)
	}
	return res, err
}

func TestSizeTrial(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	e := &Executor{Join: []string{}}
	var before string
	_ = trialStage(t, "01 canyon-builder", func() (err error) { before, err = e.BuilderImage(ctx); return err })
	_ = trialStage(t, "02 canyon-run", func() (err error) { _, err = e.RunImageID(ctx); return err })
	built := map[string]BuildResult{}
	for i, a := range trialApps() {
		res, err := trialBuild(ctx, t, e, fmt.Sprintf("%02d build %s", i+3, a.name), a.name, a.dir, "pkg_tri1")
		if err == nil {
			built[a.name] = res
		}
	}
	for _, a := range trialApps() {
		if a.name == "claims-portal" || a.name == "django-sqlite" || a.name == "go-hello" {
			_, _ = trialBuild(ctx, t, e, "10 again "+a.name, a.name, a.dir, "pkg_tri2")
		}
	}
	after, err := e.BuilderImage(ctx)
	fmt.Printf("IDENTITY before %s after %s %v\n", before, after, err)
	for _, a := range trialApps() {
		res, ok := built[a.name]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		_ = trialStage(t, "11 run "+a.name, func() error {
			_, err := e.Run(ctx, RunRequest{App: a.name, Target: "preview", Image: res.Image, Network: "canyon-app-" + a.name})
			var exited *Exited
			if errors.As(err, &exited) {
				return fmt.Errorf("exited: %s %s", exited.Reason, exited.Output)
			}
			return err
		})
		_ = e.Stop(ctx, a.name, "preview")
	}
	saved := runImage
	runImage = &scanImage{dockerfile: "FROM " + saved.repo + "\nUSER root\nRUN echo patched > /etc/canyon-trial\nUSER 1002:1001\n", repo: "canyon-run:trial"}
	run, err := e.RunImageID(ctx)
	fmt.Printf("REBASE onto %s %v\n", run, err)
	for _, a := range trialApps() {
		res, ok := built[a.name]
		if !ok || (a.name != "claims-portal" && a.name != "django-sqlite" && a.name != "go-hello") {
			continue
		}
		_ = trialStage(t, "12 rebase "+a.name, func() error {
			rebased, err := e.Rebase(ctx, RebaseRequest{App: a.name, Package: "pkg_tri1", Image: res.Image, RunImage: run})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			b, f := rebased.Before, rebased.After
			top := func(x RebaseFacts) int { return slices.Index(x.DiffIDs, x.TopLayer) }
			if top(b) < 0 || top(f) < 0 || !slices.Equal(b.DiffIDs[top(b)+1:], f.DiffIDs[top(f)+1:]) || b.BuildMetadata != f.BuildMetadata {
				return errors.New("the rebase moved more than the run image")
			}
			return nil
		})
	}
	runImage = saved
	_, _ = e.RunImageID(ctx)
	// a tree no buildpack detects, and an app whose project.toml names its buildpack by id
	none := t.TempDir()
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(none, "notes.txt"), []byte("nothing to build\n"), 0o600))
	_, err = trialBuild(ctx, t, e, "13 undetected", "nothing-here", none, "pkg_tri1")
	var undetected *Undetected
	fmt.Printf("UNDETECTED is-undetected=%v builds=%v err=%v\n", errors.As(err, &undetected), func() []string {
		if undetected == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return undetected.Builds
	}(), err)
	named := t.TempDir()
	for _, f := range []string{"package.json", "server.js"} {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("../demo/apps/claims-portal", f))
		must(t, err)
		must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(named, f), b, 0o600))
	}
	must(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(named, "project.toml"), []byte("[_]\nschema-version = \"0.2\"\n\n[[io.buildpacks.group]]\nid = \"paketo-buildpacks/nodejs\"\n"), 0o600))
	_, err = trialBuild(ctx, t, e, "14 project.toml names nodejs", "named-node", named, "pkg_tri1")
	fmt.Printf("PROJECT.TOML %v\n", err)
	must(t, os.WriteFile("/tmp/trial-verbose", nil, 0o600))
	_, _ = trialBuild(ctx, t, e, "15 verbose claims-portal", "claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_tri3")
	must(t, os.Remove("/tmp/trial-verbose"))
}

// TestSizeTrialUnreachable builds again with the registries' names pointing nowhere and every image on the host.
func TestSizeTrialUnreachable(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	_, err := trialBuild(ctx, t, &Executor{Join: []string{}}, "20 registries unreachable claims-portal", "claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_tri4")
	fmt.Printf("UNREACHABLE %v\n", err)
}

// TestSizeTrialOwnBuilder builds on a builder made on the host with the one language in it.
func TestSizeTrialOwnBuilder(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	e := &Executor{Join: []string{}, Builder: "canyon-builder-nodejs:trial"}
	id, err := e.BuilderImage(ctx)
	fmt.Printf("OWN BUILDER identity %s %v\n", id, err)
	_, err = trialBuild(ctx, t, e, "31 own builder claims-portal", "own-claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_tri5")
	fmt.Printf("OWN BUILDER build %v\n", err)
}
